Use this guide when your site is published and you have a Google Analytics 4 property with a web data stream for it. In [Google Analytics](https://analytics.google.com/), open **Admin > Data streams**, select that web stream and copy its **Measurement ID**, starting with `G-`.

## Set the measurement ID

In your repository’s **Code** tab, open `_config.yml` and click the pencil. Edit the existing `gtag_id` entry, or add it once if absent:

```
gtag_id: G-XXXXXXXXXX

```

Replace the example with your own measurement ID. Preserve unrelated settings. Leave `analytics_id` empty: it is for retired Universal Analytics, not GA4\. Do not paste an additional Google tag into your custom includes; the theme adds it from this setting. Remove a manually inserted duplicate of the same tracker.

If you want only Google Analytics, leave `goatcounter` empty. The two integrations are independent; configuring both loads both services.

## Publish and check

Save with **Commit changes** on your publishing branch. Wait for the latest run in **Actions** to succeed, then open your website from **Settings > Pages**. Visit a page and check the **Realtime** report in the matching Analytics property. Allow time for reporting and check that you copied the ID from the intended stream.

A browser blocker or a site’s custom consent controls can prevent the tracking request. Check those controls if no visit appears. Unlike GoatCounter’s built-in integration, this Google tag is not restricted to production builds; an enabled ID also loads it during local preview.
